title: Creating a Standing Order
body:
Creating a Standing Order

You can create standing orders in guided buying for goods and services configured as limit items or services inSAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA.

Context

You can use standing orders for recurring orders for low-value items and routine services. The goods or services available for standing orders are procured without following the goods receipt and the service sheet processes. These orders have validity periods and predefined amounts to limit time period and item pricing. When you submit these orders, you request a limit item.

When you create a standing order, the first item added to your cart must qualify for a standing order, or display the This is a standing order checkbox. If your administrator configured customer catalog searches, after you add the first limit item to your cart, any subsequent searches return only limit items. For more information, see Configuring Customer Catalog Searches for Standing Orders.

Standing orders can have more than one item, but they must be limit items. When you create a standing order, you must specify the ordering period (start and end dates); the recurrence period (how often it's delivered); and the expected total cost. If you add more than one item to a standing order, the specified dates for the first item apply to each subsequent item.

Procedure

  1. Search the catalog for the limit item to create the standing order.
    Tip

    Limit items display the This is a limit item checkbox. To procure a limit item as a non-limit item, deselect the checkbox. If the checkbox isn't available, the item doesn't qualify as a limit item.

  2. Check the This is a standing order checkbox and enter the following information:

    • Start date

    • End date

    • Expected amount

    • Max amount

    • Unit of measure

  3. Enter the additional details required if you are adding a parametric item. For example, if you're adding a shirt, you might be required to select its color and size.
  4. Click Add to cart. The item is added to your cart.
    Remember

    Standing orders only allow you to order 1 of each item.

  5. If you can't find the limit item in the catalog, create a non-catalog limit item request:
    1. From the home page, choose Quick Links  Request a non-catalog item.
    2. Choose the Goods or Services tab.
    3. In the Product name or Service name field, enter a name for the product or service you need.
    4. For the Category field, choose a category that describes your request. Categories that qualify for standing orders display the This is a standing order checkbox.
    5. Check the This is a standing order checkbox, enter the Start date, End date, Expected amount, and Max amount.
    6. Optional: Add a supplier.
    7. Comments: Specify the recurrence period, or how often the item or service should be delivered. For example, "Deliver this item every 2 weeks until the specified end date." The supplier delivers based on the instructions provided in this section.
    8. Click Add to cart.
  6. After you've finished adding items to your request, click Check out.
  7. Review the details on the checkout page, and then click Submit.
    A confirmation dialog box displays. Click Done to return to the home page.

Next Steps

After you submit a request, you can check on the status periodically.

A Withdraw button in the request allows you to stop the approval process and revert the document to Composing state. When you withdraw a document, you can enter comments that are added to its Comments section.
